dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Cluster of approximately five to seven high-luminance blobs concentrated on the posterior half and distal tip of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notch on the posterior margin of the upper caudal fin lobe; large high-intensity white patch at the anterior base of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced sequence of high-luminance circular clusters along the lateral line of the caudal peduncle.
